up: Retrieve distinct molecule ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), compound name (from compound_records.compound_name), and canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles) for all molecules that are linked to the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL4420072'. Only include molecules that have a non-null canonical SMILES. The links are: documents (docs) are connected to compound_records via doc_id; compound_records are connected to molecule_dictionary via molregno; molecule_dictionary is connected to compound_structures via molregno. Order the results ascending by molecule ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4420072' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, cr.compound_name, cs.canonical_smiles
